result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major missing-element problem in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, while Home, Search, and Profile all have icons. This leaves an empty gap and makes the navigation look broken and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Restore the Orders icon (e.g., a receipt/list icon) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, stroke weight, and grey color of the Search and Profile icons.
